fact: The Ministry's September 2024 Guidelines on Management of ICT Resources direct all MDACs to adopt the Government Enterprise Architecture and, in implementing it, to adhere to the Government Interoperability Framework (GIF), with ICT acquisitions required to comply with GEA and GIF.
title: Guidelines on Management of ICT Resources in Ministries, Departments, Agencies and Counties (MDACs)
publisher: Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy
